rows.col_1: POST https://developer.api.autodesk.com/construction/rfis/v3/projects/:projectId/rfis/:rfiId/comments
User context required
data:write data:create
JSON

Must be Bearer <token>, where <token> is a three-legged access token obtained via an Authorization Code flow or a Secure Service Account (SSA) flow.
The SSA flow is designed for headless server-to-server operations. While it functions like a two-legged flow (no user interaction), it is classified as three-legged because it preserves user context.
Must be application/json

The ID of the project.
Use the Data Management API to retrieve the project ID. For more information, see the Retrieve a Project ID tutorial. You need to convert the project ID into a project ID for the Forma API by removing the “b." prefix. For example, a project ID of b.a4be0c34a-4ab7 translates to a project ID of a4be0c34a-4ab7.
The ID of the RFI. To find the ID, call POST search:rfis.
The comment ID. Leave empty if you want to let the system generate one.

The content of the comment.
Max length: 10000
Created
The parameters are invalid
The provided bearer token is not valid
The user or service represented by the bearer token does not have permission to perform this operation
An unknown error occurred on the server
The unique identifier of the comment.
The content of the comment.

The Autodesk ID of the user who created the comment.
To check the name of the user, call GET users.
The timestamp of the date and time the comment was created, in the following format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sz.
The timestamp of the date and time the comment was updated, in the following format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sz.

The source of the comment. Indicates how the comment was created.
Possible values:


web – The comment was created through the web interface or API.
email – The comment was created by replying via email.
The ID of the RFI associated with this comment.

codeExamples.raw:
curl -v 'https://developer.api.autodesk.com/construction/rfis/v3/projects/:projectId/rfis/:rfiId/comments' \
  -X 'POST' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer AuIPTf4KYLTYGVnOHQ0cuolwCW2a' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
        "id": "",
        "body": "This needs more attention."
      }'
